evidence.note: Forcignanò and Martinelli Tempesta treat the extra-canonical Platonic epistles outside the traditional thirteen as spurious and discuss the individual Hercher-numbered items.
Hirsch (2026) explicitly enumerates Hercher 14, 15, 24, 25, 26, 30, 31, 70 and 85 as other letters of 'Plato' outside the thirteen-letter collection, pointing to the 2023 corpus-history treatment.

rationale: Very brief 'Plato to Axiochus' letter in later epistolographic transmission; recent corpus-history scholarship treats it as spurious.
